examples.arabic: امبارح حصلت مشكلة في البيت بين جدي واخواتي
examples.english: Yesterday a problem happened in the house between my grandpa and my siblings.
examples.transliteration: Embareh hasalet moshkela fel beit bein geddi wa akhwati.

examples.arabic: النهاردة كان فيه ماتش كورة بين صحابي
examples.english: Today there was a football match between my friends.
examples.transliteration: El-nahārda kān fīh matsh kora bēn soḥābi.

examples.arabic: النهاردة فيه ماتش كورة بين الاهلي والزمالك
examples.english: Today there is a football match between Al Ahly and Al Zamalek.
examples.transliteration: El naharda feh matsh kora bein Al Ahly w Al Zamalek.

examples.arabic: الفرق بين الاجيال كان واضح في كل اقتراح
examples.english: The difference between generations was clear in every suggestion.
examples.transliteration: El-far' bēn el-agyāl kān wāḍiḥ fī kull eqterāḥ.

examples.arabic: علي سأل جده ايه الفرق بين زمان ودلوقتي
examples.english: Ali asked his grandfather what is the difference between the past and now.
examples.transliteration: Ali sa'al geddo eih el-far' bein zaman we delwa'ti.
examples.storyTitle: The Little Boy and the Questions

examples.arabic: سارة قالت انها الفترة دي بيواجه صعوبة في تنظيم وقتها بين الشغل والبيت
examples.english: Sarah said that this period she faces difficulty organizing her time between work and home
examples.transliteration: Sara 'alet en-naha el-fatara di beywageh soouba fi tanzim wa't-ha bein el-shoghl wel-beit
